  "title": "AFSA Staff Legal Support",
  "setting": "AFSA, August 1952",
  "decider": "The comptroller",
  "agent_recast": false,

  "agent": "The comptroller",
  "agent_role": "advise",
  "situation": "AFSA needed legal guidance across its elements. Its mission and functions were not assigned by statute, and procurement remained with the Signal Corps and other agencies. Legal interpretations made within AFSA could be authoritatively reinterpreted at the level where statutory authority and responsibility rested. The comptroller considered whether to place a staff legal officer in an existing division or create a special staff division to centralize legal functions. The choice involved the breadth of legal representation and how legal advice, operational authority, and staff responsibility would be organized.",
  "question": "What should the comptroller recommend for AFSA's staff legal-support structure?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "AFSA's mission and functions were not assigned by statute.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.8"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Signal Corps and other agencies continued to handle AFSA's procurement.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.7"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The comptroller assessed that AFSA legal interpretations could be authoritatively reinterpreted at the echelon where statutory authority and responsibility rested.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.8", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The comptroller considered that overall responsibility for legal counsel should be specifically assigned at staff level.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.10", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.12"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The two alternatives under consideration were appointing a staff legal officer in an existing staff division or creating a special staff division and centralizing legal functions there.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.15", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.16"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "capability",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "A staff legal officer could represent most of the agency's legal requirements, although that arrangement would not centralize all legal activities.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.17"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The comptroller assessed that a legal division would combine advisory and operating capacities and concentrate too much power in the legal group.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.17", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.18", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.19"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The comptroller assessed that other staff divisions could shift responsibility for difficult problems to a legal division by claiming they had legal implications.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.20", "src:42da93d25b4e#p57.21"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F9",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The comptroller assessed that a legal division would not be sufficiently separated from operational groups and would conflict with itself as both a definitive line and an advisory staff element.",
      "spans": ["src:42da93d25b4e#p57.22"]
    }
